One cucumber is in the immediate foreground, showing its rounded end and textured skin with water droplets. Two other cucumbers are positioned behind it, one partially visible in the upper left and another in the upper right. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the waxy texture and small bumps on the cucumber skins.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy sheen' and 'raised bumps'. AI often struggles with the micro-texture of cucumber skin, either making it too smooth (plastic-like) or adding noise that doesn't resemble biological tubercles. Verify if the water droplets (if present) have correct refraction properties or if they look like painted-on blobs. Check the occlusion boundaries where the cucumbers overlap; AI sometimes blends edges incorrectly in these regions.
